item.title: First Night to Welcome New Year in State College With Ice Sculptures, Performances and Resolution Run
item.description: First Night State College will return to downtown State College on Dec. 31 with an alcohol-free, all-day celebration of the arts featuring ice sculptures, live performances and the annual Resolution Run 5K. The event, produced by the Central Pennsylvania Festival of the Arts, is designed as a family-focused way to welcome the New Year with visual art, music, theater and interactive programming across downtown venues. item.title: Regional Halal Restaurant Chain to Open Downtown State College Location
item.description: A growing regional chain of fast casual halal restaurants is coming to downtown State College. Sizzling Bites Halal Grill is planning to open at 129 S. Pugh St., according to signage on the building and information presented earlier this year at a State College Redevelopment Authority meeting. The location has been vacant since Sheetz closed its store there in 2023 after eight years in business. An opening date has not yet been announced. The chain plans to post updates on its Instagram account.

item.description: The NCAA calls it “the notification-of-transfer period,” when student-athletes officially inform their school, and hence, the NCAA that they are interested in changing schools. item.title: Photos: Ice Sculptors Craft Creative Designs at First Night State College
item.description: First Night State College is known for its ice sculptures — one of the largest displays of its kind in Pennsylvania — and sculptors were hard at work Wednesday morning and afternoon crafting the creative designs that are an annual highlight of the New Year's Eve celebration.
